title: Fee discount applied twice, and the exam-center form showed every institution
summary:
Two defects turned up while the fee and exam-center screens were tested. Both are fixed on this branch.

Voucher generation took the sibling discount off twice, so 312 vouchers in the staging batch were PKR 450 too low. The new exam-center form listed every institution to nazims and saved a center for any institution id it was sent. The voucher loop now uses the amount the query has already discounted, and the form and its save action both go through the role-aware `ModuleHelper::jamiaList()`.

New feature tests cover both rules, and a person repeated the checks by hand while logged in with the least-privileged role.

problems.title: Fee discount applied twice in voucher generation
problems.symptom: Students with a sibling discount got vouchers below the expected amount. Example: fee 5,000 with a 10% discount should be 4,500; the voucher said 4,050.
problems.root_cause: The fee query already returns `net_amount` with the discount taken off. The loop that writes the `voucher_detail` rows then took the discount off a second time. Each code path assumed the other one did not apply it, and no test had a discounted student.
problems.impact: In staging batch B-17, 312 of 1,240 vouchers were PKR 450 too low: about PKR 140,400 the board would not have collected. Families would have been asked for the difference later.
problems.evidence:
Voucher V-2026-00417: fee 5,000, discount 10%, printed 4,050.
The query result for the same student already showed `net_amount = 4500`.

problems.title: Exam-center form shows every institution to a nazim and accepts any institution id
problems.symptom: A nazim, who manages one institution, opened the new exam-center form and saw all 287 enabled institutions in the dropdown. Saving with another institution selected also worked.
problems.root_cause: The form built its dropdown with `Jamia::where('is_enabled', 1)->get()` instead of the project helper `ModuleHelper::jamiaList()`, which applies the superadmin / nazim / staff split. The save action trusted the submitted `jamia_id` and never checked it against the user's own list.
problems.impact: Any nazim could read the names of all institutions and create exam centers for institutions they do not manage. That breaks the separation of data between institutions and can send candidates to the wrong center.
problems.evidence: Logged in as the test user `nazim_demo` (institution #12): the dropdown listed 287 institutions. A POST with `jamia_id=45` returned HTTP 302 and created a center for institution #45.

fixes.title: Use the discounted amount from the query as it is
fixes.change: Removed the second discount calculation from the voucher loop. Each `voucher_detail` row now stores `net_amount` from the query. Added a feature test with one discounted and one non-discounted student.
fixes.why_correct: The discount is now taken off in exactly one place, the query, which is also what the fee register report reads, so vouchers and the register agree. The new test fails on the old code (4,050) and passes on the new code (4,500).

fixes.title: Build the institution dropdown with the role-aware helper
fixes.change: `create()` now calls `ModuleHelper::jamiaList()`, the helper the other forms in the project already use.
fixes.why_correct: The helper implements the three-way role split (superadmin sees all, a nazim sees their own institution, staff see the institutions mapped to them), so the form follows the project rule instead of re-implementing it.

fixes.title: Reject an institution id the user may not use
fixes.change: `store()` validates `jamia_id` against the ids returned by `ModuleHelper::jamiaList()`. A forged id now fails validation with the normal error message.
fixes.why_correct: Hiding options in a dropdown is not a security check: the server has to check the value it receives. Validation runs before any write, so nothing is saved for a forged id.

verification.check: Feature test: a discounted student's voucher is 4,500
verification.detail: `php artisan test --filter=VoucherDiscountTest`: 2 tests, 6 assertions, on the local SQLite test database.

verification.check: Batch B-17 regenerated on a local copy and compared with the fee register
verification.detail: 312 vouchers changed, each by +450. The batch total now matches the register.

verification.check: Logged in as `nazim_demo` and opened the exam-center form
Forged POST with another institution's id
verification.detail: `jamia_id=45` is rejected with a validation error; no row is created.

verification.check: Superadmin and a staff user still see their full lists
verification.detail: Superadmin sees 287 institutions; a staff user mapped to 3 institutions sees those 3.

verification.check: Other forms that build an institution dropdown
verification.detail: 14 of 19 forms checked and correct. 5 still query institutions directly (see remaining risks).

verification.check: Two voucher generations running at the same time
verification.detail: The local setup has no queue worker. Listed as a remaining risk.

scans.note: Pattern scan with `diff-check.sh origin/master`. Before the fix, the HIGH finding was the unscoped institution query. The one WARN left is a shared-table rule that does not apply to vouchers; a person reviewed it and accepted it.

approvals.action: Run the feature tests, which reset the test database
approvals.harm: RefreshDatabase wipes whatever database the tests point to. `.env.testing` was checked first: it points to a local SQLite file, not a shared server.

approvals.action: Regenerate voucher batch B-17 on the shared staging server. The user chose the safer option: a local copy.
approvals.harm: Would overwrite 1,240 vouchers that other testers are using, and cannot be undone without a backup.

remaining_risks: Five other forms still query institutions directly. They were outside this task and are not fixed yet.
Vouchers of batch B-17 printed before the fix carry the wrong amount and have to be reissued.
Two voucher generations running at the same time were not tested.
next_steps: Finance approves, then the 312 affected vouchers of batch B-17 are reissued.
Move the five remaining forms to `ModuleHelper::jamiaList()`, one small change each.
Add a project rule to `.claude/safe-code-rules.tsv` so a direct institution query is flagged in every future change.
A second developer reads the diff before it is merged.
